page_title: CAG 2-1 GEN | Cagliari v Genoa 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' The game is interrupted. Simone Scuffet (Cagliari) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tommaso Augello leaves the pitch and Adam Obert (Cagliari) comes on.
90+3' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+1' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
88' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
86' Cagliari have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
85' Koni De Winter (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
84' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replacing Ruslan Malinovsky.
84' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
82' Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) coming on for Jakub Jankto.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
71' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
69' 2 - 1 Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
67' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Cagliari was in an offside position.
66' Substitution. Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) on for Aaron Martin.
64' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Gaetano Oristanio and he is replaced by Andrea Petagna (Cagliari).
63' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
60' Cagliari have been awarded a free kick.
59' Substitution. Kevin Strootman makes way for Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
59' Today's match ends for Milan Badelj who will be replaced by George Puscas (Genoa).
59' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
57' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:1.
48' 1 - 0 Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.
46' The game is over for Pantelis Chatzidiakos (Cagliari). Gabriele Zappa comes on for the second half.
46' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) comes on the pitch for Marco Mancosu.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.
42' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Marco Guida due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) and his team.
37' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) managed to win the ball from the free kick and unleashed a strike from the goal area onto the crossbar!
35' Pantelis Chatzidiakos (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
34' Pantelis Chatzidiakos (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
31' It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
28' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
27' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
25' Milan Badelj (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
24' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
22' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' One of the Cagliari players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
19' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
18' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) produces a long-range pass.
14' Genoa are ruled offside.
11' Genoa couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Simone Scuffet (Cagliari) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
10' A player from Cagliari takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Genoa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
6' A shot from the edge of the box by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
5' The linesman signals a throw-in for Cagliari.
3' One of the players from Cagliari times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Genoa will kick-off.
Marco Guida was nominated as the referee for this game.
